title: Proposal Disposition
description: Seller-tracked lifecycle disposition of one immutable proposal snapshot, returned by list_proposals next to the unchanged snapshot. Distinct from proposal_status (draft, committed, accepted), which is part of the snapshot and never changes after issue. Sellers MUST keep a snapshot readable through list_proposals while it is available and for at least 30 days after it becomes accepted, declined, expired, or withdrawn; after that, get_media_buys remains the record for accepted terms. Experimental (media_buy.open_opportunities).

enumDescriptions.available: The snapshot can still be acted on: refined, declined, or, when committed and before expires_at, accepted. An outstanding seller offer whose base_media_buy_revision no longer matches the media buy is never available; see withdrawn. Buyers MUST NOT cache this value, because it can change without a notification. A refined source stays available unless the seller withdraws it; refinement creates new snapshots and does not retire the source.
enumDescriptions.accepted: The snapshot was executed through accept_proposal or create_media_buy. proposal_status on the snapshot is unchanged; the acceptance record is on the resulting media buy.
enumDescriptions.declined: The buyer declined the snapshot through decline_proposals. Terminal.
enumDescriptions.expired: expires_at passed before acceptance. For a committed snapshot the inventory hold is released. Terminal.
enumDescriptions.withdrawn: The seller retracted a draft snapshot before expiry, for example because the inventory sold. Terminal. A seller MUST NOT withdraw a committed snapshot before its expires_at, with one exception: an outstanding seller offer (origin seller_offer, not yet accepted, declined, or expired) made stale by a revision of the media buy, meaning its base_media_buy_revision no longer matches the buy's current revision. The seller MUST derive that state from the buy's current revision at read time and report such an offer withdrawn, never available, with disposition_changed_at set to the revision time. A revision made by accepting the offer itself is not a staleness event, and terminal dispositions never change. The offer stays readable under the retention rule and cannot be accepted. Sellers reject refine_proposals and accept_proposal for a withdrawn snapshot with INVALID_STATE, as for a declined one. There is no withdrawal notification: buyers see it through list_proposals or, when the seller implements the account change feed, a status_changed proposal record.
